newsitem.title: USA: Mednet names Robert Bagdasarian as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Mednet names Robert Bagdasarian as CEO.

text.p: Mednet, MPC Corp said Thursday that Robert Bagdasarian and Glenn Merritts had joined the managed prescription care services company as chief executive officer and president, respectively.

Bagdasarian was formerly president and chief executive officer of Rx Net Inc, a pharmacy benefit management company in Fresno, Calif., having co-founded the company and continued to manage it after its sale to Value Health Inc in 1994.

Merritts was formerly vice president of finance and chief financial officer of Rx Net. Before joining Rx Net, he was executive vice president and chief executive officer of Direct Pharmaceutical Corp, a pharmaceutical mail-order company.
